messages:
marie: quick check 11: new compact stream toolbar mock — Stop, token badge, prompt insert. figma: https://redwood.design/mini-v4

ash: looks tight. does it overlap composer suggestions?

marie: plan is bottom-right; if suggestions show we shift it left. mobile collapses to one icon.

sam: dev note: token badge should update at ~250ms debounce to avoid jank. stop = cancel request.

ben: microcopy idea: show "+N" token pill on prompt insert hover/focus to surface cost.

kai: a11y: stream region use aria-live="polite", token badge needs aria-label, toolbar must be tabbable. avoid color-only cues.

a11y-bot: checklist added: keyboard flows, NVDA/VoiceOver checks, contrast, reduced-motion support.

marie: agreed. action items: ash update comps, sam prototype debounce+esc to stop+focus, ben write +N copy, kai run quick a11y pass. will post updates. :sparkles:
